description: Beijing Normal University publishes STSR-Seg, a Python workflow that produced the China Building Rooftop Area dataset. It combines super-resolution of Sentinel-2 imagery with semantic segmentation and tunes the model using high-resolution building references and lower-resolution built-area references. The README documents environment setup, training-data preparation, model training and tiled inference, using PyTorch and Google Earth Engine. Source code is exposed on GitHub and archived as version 1.0 on Zenodo. The archive labels the licence Other Open and access is free; GitHub does not identify specific licence terms. Pretrained weights and reference imagery are separately linked and were not acquired. Accuracy depends on the training references and local imagery, and the workflow was not executed in this review. It could prepare building-exposure layers for flood or urban-energy simulations after local validation. It is the processing tool behind data-cbra-china-building-rooftop-area-2016-2021, not an additional copy of that dataset.
